claims.claim_text: The private identifier printed for James L. Allnutt resolves to a different full name in the official Army merged file, so the indexed identity remains conflicting.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact private identifier maps to a different full name in the official Army file; both the identifier and unrelated name are withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting: exact identifier agreement is strong evidence of a discrepancy, not permission to assign the different Army subject to James L. Allnutt.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record date cannot safely be attributed to the indexed James L. Allnutt while the name conflict remains unresolved.
claims.match_notes: Box 11 and the underlying Army record must be compared. No details belonging to the differently named Army subject are copied to this profile.
